intervals.description_raw: 0.00 - 2.10m: Sand with shell fragments: smear at top of core. Sand, very fine to fine, muddy, poorly sorted. Very dark greyish brown (3/2). About 25% broken thin shell debris.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 2.10 - 2.90m: Boulder clay, dusky red (3/2), sandy silty mud with small rounded pebbles including a number of thoroughly abraided shell fragments. 0.6m core recovered.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 2.90 - 4.70m: Boulder clay, dark reddish brown (3/4), ill sorted muddy sand with scattered small pebbles; passage at top. 30cm recovered.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 4.70 - 13.90m: Gravel; subangular to rounded clean pebbles. Recovery equivalent to 0.2m. Rounded pebbles and loose coarse sand comprising 50% assorted rock grains and 50% angular to rounded quartz grains; olive brown (4/4).
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 13.90 - 17.60m: Gravel; subangular to rounded pebbles mixed with sticky dark red (3/6) mud. (possibly cavings: jar labelled 16.5 to 17m). Also, Sandstone fragment, compact, hard light yellowish brown. 11x7cm stuck in core bit and much abraided by drilling.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 17.60 - 21.00m: Mudstone, dark red (3/6) with green flecks; top 0.7m recovered is contorted.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.

intervals.description_raw: 21.00 - 23.83m: Mudstone, dark red (3/6) with green flecks; level bedded and slightly micaceous.
intervals.interpretation_source: Geological data describing units in offshore samples, interpretation derived from graphic log. The graphic log contains both textual descriptions and symbology to scale for each interval and is usually the final version of a log.
